AQRP_FIXED_REVIEW_SHA: e71f6f090b102e4abfd70a5999e495f49546a1b5

## Phase6 G1 revised design — independent recheck requested
Latest independent verdict applies only to `f7a1a68c5f747090f8c8a0e934f2fea859aec998`: **PLAN BLOCKED / REQUEST CHANGES, WORK-P6-G1-001 High, 002/003 Medium**. Original report, all original failures and receipt are archived byte-for-byte. This new fixed SHA proposes design/reference repairs. **All three findings remain OPEN_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_RECHECK; no PLAN PASS or P6 implementation approval is claimed.**

Eight canonical UI-001–008 requirements remain 5 MVP + 3 Competition Ready. Six pages and CLI/SDK/UI same-core behavior remain required after separately authorized implementation. Scope remains G1 planning only, with no UI install/start or business code changes.

## Candidate fixes for the three findings
- **001 — whole-task completion:** [TASK_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.md](https://github.com/wwooyy429/Alpha-Quant-Research-Platform-AQRP-/blob/e71f6f090b102e4abfd70a5999e495f49546a1b5/docs/audits/phase-6/TASK_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.md) freezes research / engineering_pipeline / replay required stages; complete preallocated decision/P4 slots; exact artifacts, parent lineage and completion.json + SQLite terminal barrier. A single recovered P3/P4 success never promotes the Task. Missing P5, partial/failed/cancelled/unknown stages and missing global receipt remain incomplete or fail closed. Legitimate required P4 risk rejection retains core facts but is a Task-level failure; this explicit design choice awaits independent G1 review.
- **002 — actual P5-internal P4:** [NESTED_CONTEXT_CONTRACT.md](https://github.com/wwooyy429/Alpha-Quant-Research-Platform-AQRP-/blob/e71f6f090b102e4abfd70a5999e495f49546a1b5/docs/audits/phase-6/NESTED_CONTEXT_CONTRACT.md) specifies explicit context propagation through services, Simulator, nested P4 and provider checks; full immutable pre-call tuple/raw-request binding; existing parent/portfolio-runs root; resume reuses the originally registered child, replay gets new ownership. Lists all nonfinancial adapter files and preserves every existing financial/source/manifest gate. No-context legacy APIs remain unchanged. This is local engineering integrity, not real OS isolation.
- **003 — exact numbers:** [NUMERIC_REFERENCE_CONTRACT.md](https://github.com/wwooyy429/Alpha-Quant-Research-Platform-AQRP-/blob/e71f6f090b102e4abfd70a5999e495f49546a1b5/docs/audits/phase-6/NUMERIC_REFERENCE_CONTRACT.md) and reference_check.py replace ambient Decimal arithmetic with exact integer coefficient/scale and quotient/remainder HALF_EVEN. Both original numerical failures were reproduced before repair, with failing exit1/logs preserved. Original32-answer file is byte-identical. Proposed ASCII ordinary-decimal4096-digit/4098-text bounds and explicit refusals are a new G1 schema proposal, not an accepted implementation or a change to old P1–P5 numeric APIs.

## Evidence and developer disposition
Entry: [REVIEW_PACKAGE.md](https://github.com/wwooyy429/Alpha-Quant-Research-Platform-AQRP-/blob/e71f6f090b102e4abfd70a5999e495f49546a1b5/docs/audits/phase-6/REVIEW_PACKAGE.md).
Original [report](https://github.com/wwooyy429/Alpha-Quant-Research-Platform-AQRP-/blob/e71f6f090b102e4abfd70a5999e495f49546a1b5/docs/audits/phase-6/g1-f7a1a68/received/REPORT.md), [developer response](https://github.com/wwooyy429/Alpha-Quant-Research-Platform-AQRP-/blob/e71f6f090b102e4abfd70a5999e495f49546a1b5/docs/audits/phase-6/g1-f7a1a68/DEVELOPER_RESPONSE.md), FINDING_DISPOSITION / DESIGN_REVISION_IDENTITY / RECEIVED_IDENTITY and raw developer-validation logs are in docs/audits/phase-6/g1-f7a1a68/.70 original files are tracked. Original external independent ZIP584855382 bytes SHA256 `22cc883e7bd46f2b83ce4e5251505776862dedde3c532e15eddb5a8e07854273`: CRC, exact106-member set and all105 declared file sizes/hashes verified.

Actual developer design-reference checks: original32/32, supplemental95/95 (31 completion,30 binding,24 valid numeric,10 explicit refusals); both original counterexamples now match unchanged expected values;45 numeric cases ×6 Decimal contexts/traps=270 consistent observations;35 valid numeric cases checked using stdlib Fraction/round. These counts overlap and are **not product, authority, concurrency, UI or independent GPT Work tests**. Logs record original parent+dirty design and exact source/input hashes, which match this committed version. Real future fault matrix: G2_FAULT_MATRIX.md. Historical validation/ remains f7 evidence; current runs are under g1-f7a1a68/developer-validation/.

Read-only inherited P5 package check passed (12 requirements/69 modules/3444 original protected files);4738 frozen baseline files and13 prior G1 data/lock assets are byte-identical. Secret scan and staged diff checks passed. Source/tests/tools/CI/build/core lock/requirements catalog/P5 evidence unchanged; no full SDK or P6 product tests rerun for this documentation/design-only repair. Automatic CI, if successful, covers inherited P5 regression only.

## Baseline, recheck and permissions
main / phase5-baseline / v0.5.0 remain `59246f9fd391c1713b6bed65dd22280f4d248493`; old tag objects and targets retained. Review only the full40 SHA above, never drifting HEAD. Independently challenge whole-task barriers/recovery, actual nested P4 ownership/resume/replay/root and numeric precision/bounds, and decide each finding CLOSED_DESIGN or OPEN with new counterexamples. G1 PASS would still need separate user implementation authorization.

WI-R2-001/002 and overall real Windows isolation remain **DEFERRED / NOT VERIFIED**. Formal Test not run, financial approval NONE; full historical host remains unverified beyond accepted package/lock/oldRef/result replay. Original failures retained. No account/ACL/service/scheduler changes, deployment/live trading/formal Test/financial approval, P6 business implementation, merge, tag or P7.
